statements.status_notes: Druid 36.0.0 bundles commons-lang 2.6 via Hadoop transitive dependencies; commons-lang 2.x is end-of-life and fix requires upstream Druid (or Hadoop) to migrate to commons-lang3.

commons-lang 2.6 is bundled inside the leiningen standalone uber-jar as a transitive dependency of leiningen's build tooling. The 2.x branch of Apache Commons Lang is end-of-life and no upstream fix is planned; users are directed to commons-lang3 (which is also present in this image at 3.18.0 via an explicit dependency patch). The uncontrolled-recursion code path in ClassUtils requires attacker-controlled class-name input, which is not exposed by leiningen during the normal build workflows invoked through the image's entrypoint.
